The new Siri and many Apple Intelligence features are currently only available in English in iOS 27 beta in a limited number of countries, but Apple has pledged to 'quickly expand' to more countries and languages.

For the company, China is a particularly thorny issue, as local laws only allow cooperation with Chinese domestic AI companies. Reports today suggest that Apple has finally reached an agreement on this and will adopt two different models...

According to Reuters.

Apple has not yet confirmed the report, but Alibaba has issued a statement saying its Qwen model will be integrated into Apple's new operating system.

It is not yet known when the new Siri will launch in China, but this agreement should help speed up its rollout.
